about: Data the test cases use. Use invented people and public or synthetic documents only; never real personal paperwork.

accounts.note: Create fresh for each full run (use sender2@, sender3@... on a shared server).

people.note: Deliberate typo, used by the resend test.

documents.why: Main journey: two signature blocks, names, titles, dates.

documents.what: A 1-page agreement with a preamble blank, a fee blank, a checkbox, 'choose one' questions (round markers) and two signature blocks
documents.why: Radio, checkbox and pre-fill cases. Any synthetic document with these features works.

documents.what: An agreement with three parties and three signature blocks
documents.why: More than two signers; signer colours and sections.

documents.what: A scanned (image-only) PDF of any agreement
documents.why: No text layer: the AI must read it from the page image.

documents.what: A PDF with existing fillable form fields (text boxes, checkboxes or radio buttons)
documents.why: Existing widgets should be taken as fields.

documents.what: A PDF with no blanks or signature lines (e.g. an article)
documents.why: The AI should say it found nothing, not invent fields.
